_about: Lore data (docs/lore/README.md; decisions 257, 258): entries with facts, each fact saying who knows it. Code uses only status agreed. Facts, never lines to say.

entries.name: the fall of the star
entries.summary: A star fell into the land many thousands of years ago, before the town and before the Blood Rot.

facts.text: A star fell into the land long ago.
The star fell many thousands of years ago, before the town and before the clan.

entries.name: the raid that took the smith
entries.summary: The smith and his hammer were taken in a raid; by whom and why is open.

facts.text: Who raided, where, and why they took the smith and his hammer.

entries.name: the barrow under the temple
entries.summary: The barrow the town was built over: the founders plundered it for the town's gold and pushed the old dead deeper, and the temple's alms go down to keep the upper tombs quiet (docs/lore/crypt.md; decision 546, npc's side, part 3: the [Jeff] rows; lore adds the [proposal] rows).

facts.text: The crypt is a place to keep away from.
The town's founders plundered the barrow for its gold and pushed the old dead deeper.
The temple's alms go down to the dead, to keep the upper tombs quiet.
Pip carries the temple's offering down to the altar in the barrow.
